caption: The video captures a woman with long reddish-brown hair running away from the camera through a tall golden wheat field at sunset. She wears a blue sleeveless top and a long white skirt, and a straw hat on a neck strap hangs against her back. Both arms are stretched wide to her sides as her body bobs slightly up and down in a running gait already underway at the first frame and continuing to the last. The skirt flutters around her legs while the foreground wheat stalks blur past. Her hair streams mostly to the viewer's left, occasionally lifting upward before falling back to the side. The straw hat swings and tilts on its strap, shifting from lying fairly flat to angled edge-on and back again. Her outstretched arms stay roughly level but shift slightly in height as she moves. The sun sits low on the horizon to her right under a warm orange-and-grey cloudy sky, while the camera follows from behind, keeping her near the center at a roughly constant size.
